# File with a preview

Use this whenever you add knowledge or work to the project: a doc, a discussion, a screenshot, code, a change. Nothing is
filed until the person has seen it. sharingu runs no model: you read the input and shape the items; the door checks them.

## The procedure

1. **Learn the shapes.** `formats {}` lists every kind of knowledge item and every contribution shape in a line each.
   `formats {kind: "goal"}` gives one kind's fields, an example and where it shows; `formats {shape: "gtm"}` gives one
   contribution shape.
2. **Turn the input into items.** Each item is ONE of:
   - a knowledge upsert: `{kind: "goal", op: "upsert", data: {id, parent, title}}`
   - a knowledge remove: `{kind: "goal", op: "remove", data: {id}}`
   - a contribution: `{contribution: {lane: "leader", kind: "note", what, why}}`
   Keep what you read and did not turn into an item, with a word on why: it goes in `leftOut`.
   A grade and an answer are no items: show the person the grade or the pick, and once they say so send it by its own
   call, `submit_grade {checkId, verdict: "proven", proof: "<command> -> <result>"}` or `respond {qid, option: 1}`.
3. **Preview.** `preview {project: "<key>", items: [...], leftOut: [{what: "10 messages with no fact", why: "small talk"}]}`.
   Nothing is written. Show the person the answer's `text` exactly as it is (a fixed-width block), and its `url` (the same
   preview as a page in the app). Each item names the tool that files it (`filesWith`), and `parts` lists each tool with
   its items.
4. **Read the verdicts.** Each item says what will happen:
   - files at once, or waits for the owner (the reasons say why, in words);
   - needs one more thing: `needs` names the field, a hint and the `formats` call. Fix the item and preview again;
   - unchanged: it is stored already, the same;
   - refused: the door's own refusal (no seat, owner only). Leave it out.
   `reach` says what the set touches and reaches on the map, and how many graded checks a change puts in question.
5. **File, once the person says so.** Each part by its tool: `file_contribution` the contributions, `save_knowledge`
   the upserts, `remove_knowledge` the removes, each sent the previewId and the SAME items of its part, in their order:
   `save_knowledge {previewId: "<id>", items: [...the same upserts...]}`. A changed item is refused `preview_changed`, an
   item of another part `wrong_tool`. If some items are not ready, the call is refused `not_ready` unless you add
   `only: "ready"`, which files the ready ones and leaves the rest. Show each receipt's `text`: every item with its id.
6. **Check it.** `read {ref: "<id>"}` reads one filed contribution back with its grade and route.

## Know

- A preview lives an hour. After that, preview again.
- A write tool again with the same previewId is safe: a part already filed answers its first receipt, never a second
  filing.
- Each knowledge part lands whole, all or nothing. A contribution lands on its own.
- A read-only key can preview, never file.
